description: Where things are on a ship, from its deck plans: whether a ship has a venue or facility and which deck it is on (pass venue, e.g. "pizza", "theater", "Windjammer"), with forward/midship/aft and port/starboard; what is on one deck (pass deck, e.g. "10"); or, with neither, the ship's decks with a few venues each. Every answer links the deck plan pages. Venue records are not complete: a venue that isn't listed is not recorded, not missing.

ship.description: Ship name, e.g. "Allure of the Seas"

venue.description: A venue or kind of venue, e.g. "pizza", "main dining room", "bars"

name: getDeckPlan
title: Deck plan
